title: Resume from summary: compaction summary contains the value
reason_not_testable: Resume from summary is an interactive UI choice after more than an hour idle and more than 100,000 tokens, and compaction is a model request rather than a tool call. The e2e runner cannot drive it and only sees tool_response and the final reply. Non-hook control: do not resume secret-touching sessions with Resume from summary; purge transcripts before resuming.
